intent: Repair CAP-0009 handoff continuity semantics without changing the v5 shape: preserve strategic/workstream/cursor granularity, require a post-write whole-document semantic reread plus temporal refresh, and derive a fixed every-ten Fresh-Agent drill cadence from continuity_sequence. This is an extension of the existing continuity owner, not a new semantic owner.
rationale: CAP-0009 already owns repository-backed handoff, fresh-agent bootstrap and continuity drills. Sequence 87 exposed a failure inside that owner: several planning layers collapsed into paraphrases of one PostgreSQL/runtime blocker, bootstrap_instruction became mini-devlog narrative, and the writing process had no mandatory whole-document semantic reread. The smallest repair is to restore the existing field meanings, harden the close transaction and schedule periodic independent recovery drills while reusing continuity_sequence as the only counter.
